title: Baseliner

config.description: Exact immutable config revision; exactly one of config or parameters is required. Its source must match SQL FROM.

parameters.description: One JSON-encoded configuration object, not a JSON string encoded again. Full datasets or the single-dataset shorthand are parsed by the production parser.

model_output.description: Optional final model parameters destination, only in snapshot mode: DataFrame or writable database table; ClickHouse is not supported. Emitted on normal final EOF, not a recoverable checkpoint.

configuration.description:
config 与 parameters 二选一：config 引用已发布的精确配置版本；parameters 传入一次 JSON 编码的完整任务配置。
配置中定义数据来源、数据集、时间列、序列键和 value / ratio / relation 指标；model_output 可选，指定模型参数的输出目标。

inputs.description:
输入由任务配置的 source 与 datasets 决定；每个数据集配置时间列、序列键、字段映射、去重和指标。
value 使用数值列，ratio 使用分子与分母，relation 使用多个子指标；字段名和数据类型须符合对应数据集的声明。

observed.description: Current bucket observation; expected band may be NULL during cold start.

expected.null_meaning: No valid expected band during cold start or non-ready status; interpret status before using expected/lower/upper.

lower.null_meaning: NULL together with expected when the algorithm status has no valid prediction band.

upper.null_meaning: NULL together with expected when the algorithm status has no valid prediction band.

context_semantics.description: Resolve each metric against its own input dictionary; the unit column is a metric category, not a physical unit.

outputs.description: 基线评估与预测结果。result_kind 区分 evaluation 与 forecast；预测行的 observed、score、can_alert 等九项评估字段为 NULL。时间桶、单位和业务含义须结合原数据集及指标配置解释。

context_semantics.description: Resolve each metric against its own input dictionary; the unit column is a metric category, not a physical unit.

parameters_json.null_meaning: NULL when status is NotTrained; not a recoverable checkpoint.

outputs.description: 模型参数；仅配置 model_output 时产生。未训练模型的 parameters_json 为 NULL。

context_semantics.description: Resolve each metric against its own input dictionary; the unit column is a metric category, not a physical unit.

outputs.description: 关系指标的融合结果；仅在托管输出且启用 relation 指标时产生。
维护事件；仅在托管输出时产生，用于解释运行过程中的维护状态。

limitations: The production adapter supplies effective configuration and actual input associations; the structural JSON Schema alone does not replace production parsing or source validation.
Unknown field/business semantics remain unknown; no algorithm or row validation is implied.
A DataFrame or one explicitly named database relation requires exactly one dataset. Multiple datasets are resolved independently against a database channel.
Input bucket.unit explicitly selects bucket_id, ns, us, ms or s; it is independent of clock.bucket_seconds. No physical unit is inferred from a field name or from the output unit category.
forecast.horizon_buckets defaults to 0. Forecast rows target future buckets and have no observed value or evaluation/alert/update decision fields.
model_output is optional, snapshot-only and written at normal final EOF; model parameters do not constitute a recoverable checkpoint.
relation_fusion and maintenance depend on execution output context. A missing target/context keeps availability undetermined; an enabled output does not guarantee rows.

task_config.description: Structural schema only. The production parser additionally checks field references/types, unique dataset/metric identities, real timezone, finite source scopes, begin < end, source/dataset consistency, snapshot TTL, Relation basis capacity, and renew_ms + operation_timeout_ms < lease_ms.

inline_config.description: Single dataset shorthand is normalized by the production parser against SQL FROM. Schema defaults are annotations only.

results_structure.description: Evaluation and forecast share this physical schema. target_bucket and issued_after_bucket are bucket IDs; bucket_seconds is the bucket width in seconds, and timezone is the configured timezone. unit is a metric category, not a physical measurement unit.

model_parameters_structure.description: Final model parameters from a normal snapshot EOF when model_output is configured. parameters_json may be NULL for an untrained model; these rows are not recoverable checkpoints.

relation_fusion_structure.description: Relation diagnostics when that output path is enabled; the port may contain no rows. can_alert is always NULL and fusion_score may be NULL before a valid fusion result.

maintenance_structure.description: Maintenance events on the managed output path, not one row per input observation; the enabled port may produce no events.

metric.description: Structure follows the production parser. Field existence, lossless samples, profile and cross-field numeric relations remain production checks.

description: 按配置对时间序列进行基线评估与预测，支持数值、比率及多指标关系分析。
examples:
SELECT * FROM dataframe.series USING explore.baseliner WITH config = 'config.baseline@1'
-- 示例前提：该精确配置版本已发布，source 指向 dataframe.series，datasets 与其字段一致。
